agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: survey photos + RA + method statements attached to job; searchable by customer/postcode for disputes
agentic_mapping.notes: At claim time everything is a minute away, not a day-long search

agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: consultation as tracked object per application: route, submission date, officer, statutory window tracked per case, outcome recorded
agentic_mapping.notes: Windows vary by route (conservation-area notice 6 weeks; TPO applications typically 8) — track per-application, never hardcode one clock. TCPA 1990 + TPO Regs 2012.

agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: crew briefed on phones with equipment notes before leaving the yard
agentic_mapping.notes: Same dispatch pattern as trades, plus kit-cert gating

agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: per-operative tickets + per-kit 6-monthly LOLER with 90/30/7-day renewal ladder; Arb Assoc + CHAS evidence assembles from the same store
agentic_mapping.notes: NPTC is an insurance/council-panel requirement, not statute — LOLER 1998 inspections and PUWER training duties are. Never call a ticket a licence.

agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: insurer templates + day-14/30/60 chase ladder (Late Payment Act cited where earned); customer gets soft cadence in parallel
agentic_mapping.notes: Run the insurer ladder and the customer cadence as parallel tracks — never let the homeowner panic about the wait

agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: storm intake triaged by hazard + value; cheap fear-jobs declined to protect capacity for proper customers
agentic_mapping.notes: Storm season discipline: say no to the £200 fence-top so the £3k dismantle gets done
